note: Shared glossary for all Cantar de mio Cid texts. Old Spanish forms are glossed with their dictionary form (or modern Spanish equivalent) and a terse meaning; = introduces the modern Spanish spelling.

glossary.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por)
glossary.sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus)
glossary.tornava: tornar — he/she turned (imperfect); tornar = to turn, return
glossary.cabeça: cabeça — head (= cabeza; ç sounded ts)
glossary.i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
glossary.estávalos: estar + los — he-was + them: 'was … them' (estava + enclitic los)
glossary.catando: catar — looking at, beholding (gerund; archaic for mirar)
glossary.vío: veer — he saw (strong preterite of veer 'to see'; = vio, here two syllables ví-o)
glossary.abiertas: abierto — open (fem. pl.; past part. of abrir)
glossary.e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold')
glossary.alcándaras: alcándara — perch, rack (for clothes or hunting birds; Arabic loan)
glossary.pielles: piel — fur, pelt, fur garment (pl. pielles = pieles)
glossary.mudados: mudado — moulted (of a hawk: having shed feathers in captivity, i.e. trained and valuable)
glossary.mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
glossary.çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
glossary.avié: aver — he had (imperfect of aver = haber, here a full verb 'to have, hold')
glossary.fabló: fablar — he spoke (preterite; = habló, note f-)
glossary.mesurado: mesurado — measured, restrained, with mesura (courtly self-command)
glossary.grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had')
glossary.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado)
glossary.tí: tú — thee (stressed object pronoun; = ti, old accentuation)
glossary.que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque)
glossary.an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han)
glossary.buolto: bolver — stirred up, brewed, plotted (past part. of bolver = volver; bolver traición 'to weave treachery')
glossary.pienssan: pensar — they think; pensar de + inf. 'to set about (doing)' (epic formula)
glossary.aguijar: aguijar — to spur (one's horse), ride hard
glossary.las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
glossary.exida: exida — going out, departure (= salida; Latin exire)
glossary.bivar: Bivar — Vivar, the Cid's home village just north of Burgos
glossary.ovieron: aver — they had, they got (strong preterite of aver; = hubieron)
glossary.diestra: diestro — right, on the right side (fem.)
glossary.burgos: Burgos — Burgos, chief city of Old Castile
glossary.siniestra: siniestro — left, on the left side (fem.; ill-omened)
glossary.meçió: meçer — he shook (preterite of meçer 'to shake'; = meció)
glossary.y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
glossary.engrameó: engramear — he tossed, shook (the head) — rare epic verb
glossary.tiesta: tiesta — head (cf. French tête; Latin testa)
glossary.albricia: albricia — good tidings! reward-for-good-news (Arabic al-bishāra); here a defiant cry
glossary.alvar: Alvar — Álvar (Fáñez), the Cid's kinsman and lieutenant ('Minaya')
glossary.echados: echar — cast out, thrown (past part. pl.); echados somos 'we are banished'
glossary.somos: seer — we are (1st pl. of seer = ser)
glossary.tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land
glossary.roy: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (Roy Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
glossary.entróve: entrar — he entered (entró + archaic paragogic -e restored for the assonance)
glossary.pendones: pendón — pennon, lance-banner (men are counted by lances)
glossary.exien: exir — they went out (imperfect of exir 'to go out'; = salían)
glossary.veer: veer — to see (= ver; two syllables)
glossary.plorando: plorar — weeping (gerund; older pl- form of llorar — the poem uses both)
glossary.dizían: dezir — they were saying (imperfect of dezir = decir)
glossary.qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied')
glossary.si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!'
glossary.oviesse: aver — he had, he might have (imperfect subjunctive of aver; = hubiese)
glossary.conbidar: conbidar — to invite, take in as guest (= convidar)
glossary.ien: ien — they would (auxiliary of the split conditional: conbidar le ien = le convidarían; from avién)
glossary.don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift')
glossary.alfonsso: Alfonsso — Alfonso (VI, king of León and Castile)
glossary.avie: aver — he had (imperfect; unaccented spelling beside avié)
glossary.dél: de + él — from him, of him (contraction)
glossary.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand')
glossary.seellada: seellar — sealed (past part. fem.; seello < Latin sigillum, modern sello)
glossary.diessen: dar — they should give (imperfect subjunctive pl.; = diesen)
glossary.gela: ge + la — it to-him (ge = old dative 'to him/her', later se: modern se la)
glossary.diesse: dar — he should give (imperfect subjunctive; = diese)
glossary.sopiesse: saber — he should know (imperfect subjunctive of saber; = supiese)
glossary.vera: vero — true (fem.; vera palabra 'true word, sure truth')
glossary.averes: aver — goods, possessions, wealth (aver as noun, pl.)
glossary.aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day')
glossary.yentes: yente — people, folk (= gente; y- from Latin g-)
glossary.cristianas: cristiano — Christian (fem. pl.; las yentes cristianas = 'everyone')
glossary.ascóndense: asconder + se — they hide themselves (asconden + enclitic se; = esconderse)
glossary.nada: nada — nothing; por nada 'for anything (in the world)'
glossary.campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
glossary.adeliñó: adeliñar — he made straight for, headed to (preterite)
glossary.así: así — thus, so; así como 'as soon as'
glossary.puorta: puorta — door (older uo-diphthong spelling of puerta)
glossary.fallóla: fallar + la — he-found-it (falló + enclitic la; fallar = hallar, note f-)
glossary.pararan: parar — they had arranged, agreed (pluperfect in -ra; parar 'to arrange, settle')
glossary.quebrantás: quebrantar — he should break (apocopated imperfect subjunctive = quebrantasse)
glossary.abriessen: abrir — they should open (imperfect subjunctive pl.; = abriesen)
glossary.vozes: voz — voice (pl.; a altas vozes 'at the top of their voices')
glossary.querién: querer — they wished, would (imperfect 3rd pl.; = querían)
glossary.tornar: tornar — to return; tornar palabra 'to answer a word'
glossary.llegaua: llegar — he drew near (imperfect; copyist's u-for-v spelling of llegava)
glossary.ferídal: ferida + le — a blow to-it (ferida 'blow, stroke', = herida, note f-; + enclitic l(e))
glossary.era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser)
glossary.ojo: ojo — eye; a ojo 'in plain sight'
glossary.parava: parar — she placed, stationed (imperfect; se parava 'she stood forth')
glossary.ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already'
glossary.buena: bueno — good (fem.); en buen(a) '(born/girded) in a good hour' — the poem's honorific formula
glossary.çinxiestes: çeñir — you girded (strong preterite 2nd pl. of çeñir; Latin cinxistis)
glossary.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha)
glossary.osariemos: osar — we would dare (conditional 1st pl.; = osaríamos)
glossary.coger: coger — to take in, shelter (here = acoger) · also coger — to take up, strike (a tent: coger la tienda)
glossary.perderiemos: perder — we would lose (conditional 1st pl.; = perderíamos)
glossary.casa: casa — house; also settlement, town (Burgos la casa 'the town of Burgos')
glossary.ganades: ganar — you gain (2nd pl. present; = ganáis)
glossary.vala: valer — may he avail, protect (present subjunctive; vos vala 'may he keep you')
glossary.vertudes: vertud — power, virtue (= virtud; sus vertudes santas 'his holy powers')
glossary.dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
glossary.tornós: tornar + se — she turned back (tornó + -s(e): after a stressed vowel -se shrinks to -s)
glossary.vede: veer — he sees (older present vede, Latin videt; MS reads vee)
glossary.partiós: partir + se — he departed (partió + -s(e); partirse 'to take one's leave')
glossary.dela: de + la — from the (copyist's run-together spelling)
glossary.aguijaua: aguijar — he spurred (imperfect; copyist's u-for-v spelling of aguijava)
glossary.santa: santo — Saint (fem.); Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos
glossary.maría: María — Mary; Santa María, the cathedral of Burgos
glossary.fincó: fincar — he planted, set firm (preterite; fincar los inojos 'to kneel')
glossary.inojos: inojo — knee (= hinojo; fincar los inojos 'to kneel')
glossary.fecha: fazer — made, done (past part. fem. of fazer = hacer; = hecha, note f-)
glossary.arlançón: Arlançón — the Arlanzón, the river of Burgos
glossary.cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year')
glossary.çinxo: çeñir — he girded (strong preterite 3rd sg.; Latin cinxit)
glossary.commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como)
glossary.fosse: seer — he were (imperfect subjunctive of seer; MS fuesse, Pidal's older form)
glossary.l: le — to him (elided before vowel: l'an = le han)
glossary.conpra: conpra — buying, purchase (= compra) · also comprar — he/she buys (present 3rd sg.; = compra), as in non lo conpra, 'he does not buy it'
glossary.quantas: quanto — as many as (fem. pl.; = cuantas)
glossary.osarien: osar — they would dare (conditional 3rd pl.; = osarían)
glossary.al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least'
glossary.dinarada: dinarada — a penny's-worth (what one dinero buys)
glossary.martín: Martín (Antolínez) — a knight of Burgos, companion of the Cid, who provisions him on his exile and negotiates the loan from Raquel and Vidas
glossary.antolínez: Antolínez — surname of Martín Antolínez, the Burgalese knight who aids the Cid
glossary.burgalés: burgalés — a man of Burgos (noun/adj.; el Burgalés, an epithet of Martín Antolínez)
glossary.conplido: conplido — complete, accomplished (past part. used as adj.; = cumplido, a term of praise)
glossary.abástales: abastar + les — he supplies them (abasta, present 3rd sg. of abastar 'to supply, provide', + enclitic les)
glossary.vino: vino — wine (noun); also venir — he came (strong preterite 3rd sg.; por en vino a aquesto, 'that is how he came to this pass')
glossary.todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
glossary.conducho: conducho — provisions, victuals (Latin conductus; covers everything an army eats)
glossary.ovo: aver — he had (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = hubo; here perfect auxiliary, ovo bastidos = 'he had furnished')
glossary.bastidos: bastir — furnished, equipped (past part. masc. pl., still agreeing with its object, los … bastidos)
glossary.pagós: pagar + se — he was pleased, was satisfied (pagó + -s(e): -se shrinks to -s after a stressed vowel; = pagóse)
glossary.so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira')
glossary.odredes: oír — you will hear (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = oiréis; the minstrel's aside to his listeners)
glossary.dicho: dezir — said (past part.; a dicho = ha dicho, 'he has said')
glossary.canpeador: Campeador — spelling variant with n for m (copyist's spelling) of Campeador, the Cid's epithet
glossary.ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour'
glossary.fostes: seer — you were (archaic 2nd pl. preterite of ser, used respectfully to one person; = fuestes)
glossary.noch: noche — night (apocopated form of noche; cf. anoch)
glossary.yagamos: yazer — let us lie down, let us spend the night (present subjunctive/hortative 1st pl.; Latin iacere)
glossary.vayámosnos: ir + nos — let us go away (hortative vayamos + reflexive enclitic nos, the stem-final -s retained before the pronoun; = vayámonos)
glossary.matino: matino — morning (= la mañana; al matino 'in the morning')
glossary.seré: seer — I shall be (future 1st sg. of ser)
glossary.he: aver — I have (1st sg. present; perfect auxiliary, = he, and the auxiliary of the split future, e.g. doblar vos he)
glossary.ira: ira — wrath; en ira del rey = to be formally cast into the king's disgrace and exile, a legal idiom, not a mere figure of speech
glossary.alffons: Alfonso — Alfonso VI, king of Castile and León (copyist's shortened spelling, cf. alfons, alfonsso)
glossary.metido: meter — put, cast (past part.; seré metido = 'I shall be put/cast')
glossary.vusco: vusco — you (old fused form, con vusco = con vos, 'with you'; cf. convusco)
glossary.o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?')
glossary.çerca: çerca — near; here adverbial, çerca o tarde = 'sooner or later' (= cerca)
glossary.querer: querer — to want, wish (infinitive; head of the split future querer m'a = me querrá, 'he will want me')
glossary.m: me — me, to me (elided form of me before a vowel, querer m'a = me querrá)
glossary.quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto)
glossary.no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
glossary.preçio: preçiar — I value, prize (present 1st sg.; = aprecio)
glossary.un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
glossary.figo: figo — fig (= higo); non preçiar un figo, 'not to value at a fig', an idiom of contempt for something worthless
glossary.sodes: seer — you are (2nd pl. present, used respectfully to one person; = sois; old -edes ending, cf. odredes, vedes, catedes)
glossary.lança: lança — lance (= lanza); ardida lança, 'bold lance', stands for the bold man who wields it
glossary.doblar: doblar — to double (infinitive; split future doblar vos he = os doblaré)
glossary.soldada: soldada — wages, pay (of a retained man; from sueldo)
glossary.espeso: espender — spent (past part.; = gastado; Latin expendere)
glossary.veedes: veer — you see (2nd pl. present, old -edes ending; = veis)
glossary.trayo: traer — I carry, bring (present 1st sg.; = traigo)
glossary.huebos: huebos — need (Latin opus); huebos (me) ser/aver = 'to have need (of)'
glossary.serié: seer — it would be (conditional 3rd sg.; = sería)
glossary.compaña: conpaña — company, retinue (= compañía; spelling variant with m of conpaña)
glossary.fer: fazer — to do, make (short infinitive form; = hacer; fer lo he = lo haré, split future)
glossary.avrié: aver — there would be, he/it would have (conditional 3rd sg.; = habría)
glossary.bastir: bastir — to build, rig up, equip (the verb for Martín Antolínez's honest provisioning at v. 68, now used of the counterfeit chests)
glossary.inchámoslas: inchir + las — let us fill them (hortative inchamos + enclitic las; inchir = hinchir 'to fill', Latin implere)
glossary.d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena)
glossary.guadalmeçí: guadalmeçí — tooled, gilded leather of the costliest kind (Arabic loan, from Ghadāmes; cf. guadameçís)
glossary.enclaveadas: enclavear — studded, nailed (past part. fem. pl.; = enclavadas)
glossary.guadameçís: guadalmeçí — gilded leather (spelling variant without l, the same word as guadalmeçí)
glossary.vermejos: vermejo — bright red, crimson (masc. pl.; = bermejo)
glossary.raquel: Raquel — one of the two Jewish moneylenders of Burgos who take the pawned chests
glossary.vidas: Vidas — the other of the two Jewish moneylenders of Burgos, partner of Raquel
glossary.vayádesme: ir + me — go for me (vayades, 2nd pl. imperative/subjunctive of ir, old -ades ending, + enclitic me)
glossary.compra: conpra — buying, purchase (spelling variant with m of conpra)
glossary.ayrado: ayrar — angered, placed in disgrace (past part.; = airado; el rey me a ayrado, 'the king has turned his wrath on me', the legal condition of ira)
glossary.aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have')
glossary.es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida)
glossary.enpeñar: enpeñar — to pledge, pawn (infinitive; = empeñar; split future enpeñar gelo he = se lo empeñaré)
glossary.gelo: ge + lo — it to him/them (ge, ancestor of modern se, + lo; = se lo)
glossary.fore: seer — it may be (future subjunctive 3rd sg. of ser; = fuere)
glossary.guisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable, right (past part. used as adj.)
glossary.lieven: llevar — let them carry (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; = lleven)
glossary.cristianos: cristiano — Christian(s) (masc. pl.); moros nin cristianos / cristianos alone idiomatically = 'anyone at all'
glossary.véalo: veer + lo — may he (the Creator) see it (present subjunctive vea + enclitic lo)
glossary.santos: santo — saint (masc. pl.); los sos santos 'his saints'
glossary.fago: fazer — I do, make (present 1st sg.; = hago)
glossary.detardava: detardar — was delaying (imperfect 3rd sg.; = tardaba, se retrasaba)
glossary.passó: passar — he passed, crossed (preterite 3rd sg.; = pasó)
glossary.castiello: castiello — castle (= castillo; here the castle quarter of Burgos)
glossary.demandava: demandar — he was asking after, inquiring for (imperfect 3rd sg.)
glossary.uno: uno — one; en uno = 'together, as one'
glossary.ganados: ganar — gained, earned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with its object, as with ovo bastidos; avien ganados = habían ganado)
glossary.guisa: guisa — manner, fashion; a guisa de 'in the fashion of'
glossary.menbrado: menbrado — prudent, shrewd (lit. 'mindful', from membrar 'to bear in mind')
glossary.caros: caro — dear, beloved (masc. pl.; not 'expensive' here)
glossary.poridad: poridad — secrecy, privacy, confidence (= puridad); en poridad 'in confidence'
glossary.fablar: fablar — to speak (infinitive; = hablar, note f-)
glossary.querría: querer — I would like, would want (conditional 1st sg.)
glossary.detardan: detardar — they delay (present 3rd pl.; cf. detardava)
glossary.apartaron: apartar — they drew aside, withdrew (preterite 3rd pl., reflexive se apartaron)
glossary.manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding
glossary.descubrades: descubrir — you (may) reveal, betray (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = descubráis)
glossary.moros: moro — Moor (masc. pl.); a moros nin a cristianos, 'to any living soul' (merism)
glossary.siempre: siempre — always, forever; por siempre 'for ever'
glossary.faré: fazer — I shall make (future 1st sg.; = haré)
glossary.seades: seer — you may be (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = seáis)
glossary.menguados: menguado — diminished, in want, needy (past part./adj. pl.)
glossary.parias: paria — tribute paid by the Muslim taifa kingdoms to Castile (pl.)
glossary.fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something')
glossary.entrado: entrar — entered, gone in (past part.; f[o] entrado = 'had gone in', a ser + participle periphrasis)
glossary.priso: prender — he took (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = prendió, tomó)
glossary.sobejanos: sobejano — excessive, abundant beyond measure (masc. pl. adj.)
glossary.retovo: retener — he kept back, retained (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = retuvo)
glossary.dellos: de + ellos — of them, from them (contraction)
glossary.algo: algo — something; the poem's discreet word for money, wealth
glossary.esmerado: esmerar — refined, assayed, purified (past part.; of gold, the costliest kind)
glossary.dexado: dexar — left, left behind (past part.; = dejado)
glossary.palaçios: palaçio — great hall, manor-house (pl.; = palacio, here not 'royal palace')
glossary.aquellas: aquel — those (fem. pl.; here referring back to the chests)
glossary.levar: levar — to carry, carry off (= llevar)
glossary.sinon: sinon — if not, otherwise, but rather (= sino, si no)
glossary.ventado: ventar — scented out, got wind of (past part.; a hunting word, 'nosed out')
glossary.dexar: dexar — to leave (infinitive; = dejar; split future dexar las ha = las dejará)
glossary.mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping'
glossary.prestalde: prestar + le — lend to him! (imperative prestad + enclitic le, with Old Spanish metathesis -dl- > -ld-; = prestadle)
glossary.sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
glossary.metedlas: meter + las — put them! (imperative meted + enclitic las)
glossary.salvo: salvo — safety, safe-keeping (noun; en vuestro salvo 'in your safe keeping')
glossary.fedes: fe — pledged faiths (Pidal's restored older plural of fe 'faith, troth'; meted las fedes = 'pledge your faith')
glossary.catedes: catar — you may look into, inspect (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending; catar here = 'to look into, inspect')
glossary.seiense: seer + se — they were sitting (themselves) (seíen + enclitic se, periphrastic with gerund: seiense consejando = 'sat taking counsel')
glossary.nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us')
glossary.gañado: ganar — gained, earned (past part.; = ganado, here spelled with ñ)
glossary.qui: qui — he who, whoever (old relative pronoun, Latin qui; = quien)
glossary.monedado: monedar — coined, minted (past part. used as adj.; aver monedado = 'wealth in coin')
glossary.prendámoslas: prender + las — let us take them (hortative prendamos + enclitic las)
glossary.metamos: meter — let us put (hortative subjunctive 1st pl.)
glossary.dezidnos: dezir + nos — tell us! (imperative dezid + enclitic nos; = decidnos)
glossary.pagado: pagar — satisfied, pleased; also paid (past part.; será pagado = 'he will be content with')
glossary.respuso: responder — he answered (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = respondió)
glossary.myo: mio — my (unstressed possessive, variant spelling of mio)
glossary.ssea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; spelling variant of sea)
glossary.aguisado: guisar — fitting, reasonable (past part. used as adj.; variant of guisado)
glossary.pedir: pedir — to ask, request (infinitive; split future pedir vos a = os pedirá)
glossary.acógensele: acoger + se + le — they gather to him, flock to him (acógense + enclitic le, reflexive and dative both glued to the verb)
glossary.partes: parte — part, quarter, direction (pl.); de todas partes 'from every quarter'
glossary.menester: menester — need; a menester = ha menester, 'he has need of'
glossary.marcos: marco — mark (a unit of weight for silver, pl.)
glossary.dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos)
glossary.gelos: ge + los — them to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + los; = se los)
glossary.hemos: aver — we will/shall (1st pl. future auxiliary; restored by Pidal in the split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos)
glossary.vedes: veer — you see (2nd pl. present, old -edes ending; = veis)
glossary.entra: entrar — it comes in, enters (present 3rd sg.)
glossary.pressurado: apresurar — hurried, pressed for time (past part.; = apresurado)
glossary.dedes: dar — you may give (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = deis)
glossary.faze: fazer — is done, is made (present 3rd sg.; = hace)
glossary.desso: desso — of that, with that (= de eso)
glossary.pago: pagar — I am content, satisfied (present 1st sg., reflexive me pago)
glossary.tred: trer/traer — come! come along! (2nd pl. imperative, old form, intransitive sense of traer; = venid)
glossary.contado: contar — renowned, esteemed (past part. used as a standing epithet of the Campeador) · also of others: un Burgalés contado, 'a renowned man of Burgos' (Martín Antolínez)
glossary.meterlas: meter + las — to put them (infinitive meter + enclitic las)
glossary.sepan: saber — may know, should know (present subjunctive 3rd pl.)
glossary.pagamos: pagar — we are content, satisfied (present 1st pl., reflexive nos pagamos)
glossary.archas: arca — chest, coffer (pl.; spelling variant with ch of arcas)
glossary.aduchas: aducir — brought (irregular past part. fem. pl. of aducir)
glossary.prendet: prender — take! (2nd pl. imperative, variant spelling of prended)
glossary.seyesçientos: seysçientos — six hundred (spelling variant of seysçientos/seiscientos)
glossary.caualgó: cavalgar — he rode, mounted (preterite 3rd sg.; copyist's u-for-v spelling of cavalgó; = cabalgó)
glossary.voluntad: voluntad — will, willingness; de voluntad e de grado, a doubled formula, 'willingly and gladly'
glossary.ventassen: ventar — should scent out, get wind of (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.; hunting word)
glossary.nado: nacer — born (past part.; = nacido); omne nado, 'man born', an all-inclusive idiom like moros nin cristianos
glossary.afévoslos: afé + vos + los — here/behold them for you (afé, the poem's pointing word, origin disputed, perhaps Arabic hā 'behold', + two enclitic pronouns vos + los)
glossary.besáronle: besar + le — they kissed him (preterite besaron + enclitic le; besar las manos, the formal courtesy owed to a lord)
glossary.sonrrisós: sonrreír + se — he smiled (sonrrisó + -s(e); = sonrrisóse, -se reduced to -s after a stressed vowel)
glossary.avédesme: aver + me — you-have … me (avedes, 2nd pl. present of aver, old -edes ending, + enclitic me; = habéis + me, perfect auxiliary; avédesme olbidado = 'you have forgotten me', a host's mock-reproach)
glossary.exco: exir — I go out, I leave (present 1st sg. of exir; = salgo; cf. exien)
glossary.quem: que + me — that to me (= que me, worn down to a single consonant, cf. nol)
glossary.semeja: semejar — it seems, appears (present 3rd sg.; = parece)
glossary.avredes: aver — you will have (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = habréis)
glossary.mientra: mientra — while, as long as (= mientras)
glossary.vivades: vivir — you may live (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = viváis)
glossary.seredes: seer — you will be (future 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = seréis)
glossary.pleyto: pleyto — covenant, agreed terms, bargain (Latin placitum; = pleito)
glossary.parado: parar — settled, arranged (past part.; el pleyto a parado = 'has settled the agreement')
glossary.sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas)
glossary.gelas: ge + las — them for/to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + las; = se las)
glossary.guardarien: guardar — they would guard (conditional 3rd pl.; = guardarían)
glossary.fasta: fasta — until, as far as (= hasta)
glossary.assil: assí + le — thus to him (assí + enclitic l(e))
glossary.dieran: dar — they had given (pluperfect in -ra; = habían dado)
glossary.fed: fe — pledged faith, troth (Pidal's restored older form of fe)
glossary.auien: aver — they had (imperfect 3rd pl., copyist's u-for-v spelling; = avían/habían)
glossary.catassen: catar — they should look into, inspect (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl.)
glossary.fossen: seer — they should be (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. of ser, Pidal's older form; = fuesen; cf. fosse)
glossary.dinero: dinero — penny (a small coin, the unit of smallest denomination)
glossary.malo: malo — bad; un dinero malo, 'one bad penny' — a debased coin, naming the smallest thing worth mentioning
glossary.carguen: cargar — let them load (present subjunctive used as imperative, 3rd pl.)
glossary.levaldas: levar + las — carry them off! (imperative levad + enclitic las, with metathesis -dl- > -ld-; = llevadlas)
glossary.ponedlas: poner + las — put them! (imperative poned + enclitic las)
glossary.convusco: con + vusco — with you (fused form; cf. con vusco, v. 75)
glossary.adugamos: aducir — let us bring, fetch (hortative subjunctive 1st pl.)
glossary.mover: mover — to move, set out (infinitive; a mover [h]a = ha de mover, 'he has to set out', aver a + infinitive for obligation)
glossary.cante: cantar — may crow, may sing (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
glossary.gallo: gallo — cock, rooster; ante que cante el gallo, 'before the cock crows'
glossary.cargar: cargar — to load; al cargar de las arcas, 'at the loading of the chests'
glossary.veriedes: veer — you would have seen (conditional 2nd pl.; = veríais; the minstrel's aside to the audience)
glossary.podien: poder — they could, were able (imperfect 3rd pl.; = podían)
glossary.somo: somo — top, summit; en somo 'on top'
glossary.maguer: maguer — although (a rare word, of Greek origin)
glossary.grádanse: gradar + se — they rejoice, take pleasure (reflexive present 3rd pl.; = se alegran)
glossary.monedados: monedar — coined, minted (past part. pl.; cf. monedado sg.)
glossary.visquiessen: vivir — they might live (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., strong irregular form; = viviesen)
glossary.refechos: refazer — restored, set up again, made rich (past part. pl.)
glossary.manol: mano + le — hand + to him (enclitic le reduced to l)
glossary.besada: besar — kissed (past part. fem., agreeing with mano; ha besada = 'has kissed')
glossary.cinxiestes: çeñir — you girded (strong preterite 2nd pl., respectful to one person; = ceñisteis)
glossary.ides: ir — you go (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = vais)
glossary.ondrada: ondrar — honored, splendid (past part. fem. used as adj.; = honrada)
glossary.aya: aver — I may have (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = haya)
glossary.plazme: plazer + me — it pleases me (plaze + enclitic me; = me place)
glossary.daquí: de + aquí — from here (contraction); daquí = 'from now on'
glossary.mandada: mandar — promised, pledged; ordered (past part. fem.)
glossary.aduxier: aducir — (if) I/he shall bring (future subjunctive 1st/3rd sg., apocopated for aduxiere; = trajere)
glossary.contalda: contar — count it! (imperative contad + la with metathesis of -dl- to -ld-; = contadla)
glossary.ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun)
glossary.medio: medio — middle; en medio de 'in the middle of'
glossary.palaçio: palaçio — hall, palace; the main room of a house (= palacio)
glossary.rançal: rançal — a fine linen cloth (= ranzal)
glossary.tod: todo — all, the whole (apocopated before a vowel)
glossary.primer: primero — first (apocopated masc. before a noun)
glossary.colpe: colpe — blow, stroke, instance (= golpe); a tod el primer colpe 'at the very first go'
glossary.notólos: notar + los — he counted them (notó, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic los)
glossary.martino: Martino — Martín (Antolínez), with the -o form of the name (don Martino)
glossary.fablava: fablar — he was speaking (imperfect 3rd sg.; = hablaba)
glossary.mereçía: mereçer — I/he deserved (imperfect 1st/3rd sg.; = merecía); also modest 'I would deserve'
glossary.entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together'
glossary.ixieron: exir — they went out (preterite 3rd pl.; = salieron)
glossary.démosle: dar + le — let us give him (present subjunctive 1st pl. demos + enclitic le)
glossary.buscado: buscar — sought; procured, brought about (past part.)
glossary.mereçedes: mereçer — you deserve (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = merecéis)
glossary.darvos: dar + vos — to give you (infinitive + enclitic vos)
glossary.queremos: querer — we wish, we want (present 1st pl.)
glossary.fagades: fazer — you may make (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; = hagáis)
glossary.dámosvos: dar + vos — we give you (present 1st pl. damos + enclitic vos)
glossary.mereçer: mereçer — to deserve; to earn back, repay (infinitive; first half of a split future in mereçer no' lo hedes)
glossary.hedes: aver — you have (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = habéis); auxiliary of the split future, mereçer no' lo hedes 'you will repay us'
glossary.atorgar: atorgar — to grant, consent to (infinitive; = otorgar; first half of a split future)
glossary.gradeçiólo: gradeçer + lo — he thanked (him/it) (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = agradeció)
glossary.gradó: gradar — he was glad, took pleasure (preterite 3rd sg.; gradó exir 'he was glad to go out')
glossary.exir: exir — to go out, leave (infinitive; = salir)
glossary.espidiós: espedirse — he took leave (espidió + enclitic reflexive se, preterite 3rd sg.; = se despidió)
glossary.exido: exir — gone out (past part.; exido es 'has gone out', ser as perfect auxiliary)
glossary.nasco: nacer — he was born (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
glossary.reçibiólo: reçibir + lo — he received him (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = lo recibió)
glossary.abiertos: abierto — open (masc. pl.; past part. of abrir)
glossary.venides: venir — you come (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = venís)
glossary.vea: veer — may I/he see (present subjunctive 1st/3rd sg.; = vea)
glossary.ayades: aver — you may have (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hayáis)
glossary.vayamos: ir — let us go (present subjunctive 1st pl., exhortative; = vayamos)
glossary.san: santo — Saint (apocopated before a name; = san)
glossary.pero: Pero — Peter (San Pero = San Pedro, the saint of the monastery)
glossary.cardeña: Cardeña — San Pedro de Cardeña, the Benedictine monastery near Burgos where Ximena is lodged
glossary.veremos: veer — we shall see (future 1st pl.; = veremos)
glossary.menbrada: menbrado — prudent, sensible (fem.; lit. 'mindful', from membrar 'to bear in mind')
glossary.dalgo: de + algo — of something; fija dalgo 'daughter of something', well-born (= hidalga)
glossary.mesuraremos: mesurar — we shall measure, keep within measure (future 1st pl.); mesuraremos la posada, probably 'we shall cut our stay short' (sense uncertain)
glossary.quitaremos: quitar — we shall leave, give up (future 1st pl.; quitar el reynado 'leave the kingdom')
glossary.plazdo: plazdo — term, time limit, appointed day (= plazo)
glossary.dichas: dezir — said, spoken (past part. fem. pl.; = dichas)
glossary.cogida: coger — taken up, struck (past part. fem.; la tienda es cogida 'the tent is struck')
glossary.conpañas: conpaña — company, retinue, band of followers (pl.; = compañas)
glossary.cavalgan: cavalgar — they ride, mount (present 3rd pl.; = cabalgan)
glossary.santigua: santiguar — he crosses himself, blesses (present 3rd sg.; la cara se santigua 'crosses his face')
glossary.válanme: valer + me — may they help me (present subjunctive 3rd pl. + enclitic me; = válganme)
glossary.gloriosa: glorioso — glorious (fem.; used as address to the Virgin)
glossary.quito: quitar — I leave, give up (present 1st sg.)
glossary.ayude: ayudar — may she help (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
glossary.acorra: acorrer — may she succour, come to the aid of (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
glossary.fiziéredes: fazer — (if) you do, should do (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hiciereis)
glossary.complida: complir — fulfilled, accomplished (past part. fem.; = cumplida) · also complido — full, perfect, accomplished (adjective, fem.; = cumplida)
glossary.mando: mandar — I promise, vow; I order (present 1st sg.)
glossary.debdo: debdo — debt, obligation (= deuda); aver en debdo 'to be bound by a vow'
glossary.faga: fazer — may I/he make, cause (present subjunctive 1st/3rd sg.; = haga); faga cantar 'have sung'
glossary.cantar: cantar — to sing; cantar missas 'to say masses' (infinitive)
glossary.spidiós: espedirse — he took leave (espidió + enclitic reflexive se, preterite 3rd sg., with e- dropped; = se despidió)
glossary.caboso: caboso — accomplished, excellent (adj., also used alone as a noun, 'the excellent one')
glossary.veré: veer — I shall see (future 1st sg.; = veré)
glossary.castigar: castigar — to instruct, advise (infinitive; castigar los he = 'I shall instruct them', split future)
glossary.abrán: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl.; = habrán); abrán a far 'they will have to do'
glossary.far: far — to do (apocopated infinitive of fazer; = hacer)
glossary.quisiere: querer — shall wish (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quisiere)
glossary.incal: incaler — it matters (present 3rd sg., impersonal, apocopated; a mi non m'incal 'it does not matter to me', = importa)
glossary.quiera: querer — may (it) wish, be about to (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quiera)
glossary.rayar: rayar — to dawn, to send out rays (infinitive)
glossary.tornavas: tornar + se — he turned back (tornava + enclitic reflexive se, imperfect 3rd sg.; = se tornaba)
glossary.quel: que + le — who ... him (que + enclitic/elided le)
glossary.sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure'
glossary.quieren: querer — they wish, are about to (present 3rd pl.)
glossary.crebar: crebar — to break (infinitive; = quebrar); crebar albores 'dawn to break'
glossary.sancho: Sancho — the abbot of San Pedro de Cardeña
glossary.rezaba: rezar — he was praying, reciting (imperfect 3rd sg.)
glossary.matines: matín — matins, the early-morning office of prayer (pl.; = maitines)
glossary.abuelta: abuelta — together with, at the same time as (a + vuelta; = a vuelta de)
glossary.doña: doña — lady (title; Latin domina, fem. of don)
glossary.pro: pro — worth, merit; de pro 'worthy, of good standing'
glossary.tú: tú — thou, you (2nd sg. subject pronoun; used in prayer to God)
glossary.val: valer — help! (imperative 2nd sg., apocopated for vale; = vale)
glossary.llamavan: llamar — they were calling, knocking (imperfect 3rd pl.; = llamaban)
glossary.sopieron: saber — they learned, found out (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = supieron)
glossary.mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order')
glossary.dieron: dar — they gave (preterite 3rd pl.; dar salto 'to leap')
glossary.gradéscolo: gradecer + lo — I thank (God) for it (present 1st sg. gradesco + enclitic lo; = lo agradezco)
glossary.adobaré: adobar — I shall prepare, provide (future 1st sg.; = adobaré)
glossary.dovos: dar + vos — I give you (present 1st sg. do + enclitic vos; = os doy)
glossary.algún: alguno — some, any (apocopated before a noun; = algún)
glossary.visquiero: vivir — (if) I live, should live (future subjunctive 1st sg., on the strong stem visqu- of the preterite visque; = viviere)
glossary.seervos: seer + vos — to be … to you (infinitive + enclitic vos, first half of a split future: seervos han = os serán)
glossary.han: aver — they have (present 3rd pl.; = han); after an infinitive, the auxiliary of a split future (seervos han = os serán)
glossary.doblados: doblar — doubled (past part. masc. pl.; = doblados)
glossary.evades: evades — look, here you have (presentative; the make-up of the form is uncertain; = he aquí, ved aquí)
glossary.çient: çient — hundred (apocopated before a noun; = cien)
glossary.ella: ella — she, her (stressed 3rd sg. fem. pronoun)
glossary.sirvádeslas: servir + las — may you serve them, you are to serve them (present subjunctive 2nd pl. used as a command, + enclitic las; = que las sirváis)
glossary.est: este — this (apocopated masc.; est año = este año)
glossary.prendetlas: prender + las — take them! (imperative 2nd pl. prended, with -d- written -t- before las, + enclitic; = prendedlas)
glossary.acomiendo: acomendar — I entrust, commend (present 1st sg.; = encomiendo)
glossary.dellas: de + ellas — of them, about them (contraction, fem. pl.)
glossary.falleçiere: fallecer — (if) it should fail, run out (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = faltare)
glossary.menguare: menguar — (if) it should lack, fall short (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = menguare)
glossary.abastad: abastar — supply! provide for! (imperative 2nd pl.; = abastad)
glossary.marco: marco — mark (a unit of weight/money for silver, sg.)
glossary.despendades: despender — (that) you spend (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = gastéis)
glossary.otorgado: otorgar — granted, agreed to (past part.; otorgado gelo avie 'he had granted it to him'; = otorgado)
glossary.afevos: afevos — behold, here is/are (presentative, a + fe + vos; = he aquí, ahí tenéis)
glossary.do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde)
glossary.va: ir — he/she goes (present 3rd sg.; = va); ir + gerund, 'to be (gradually) doing'
glossary.ilegando: llegar — arriving, coming up (gerund; = llegando; Pidal's print has ilegando, read as llegando)
glossary.señas: señas — one each, one apiece (distributive adjective, fem. pl., Latin singulas; = sendas)
glossary.adúzenlas: aduzir + las — they bring them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic las; = aducir; = las traen)
glossary.ant: ant — before, in front of (apocopated ante)
glossary.llorava: llorar — she was weeping (imperfect 3rd sg.; = lloraba)
glossary.quísol: querer + le — she wanted (to …) him, i.e. she sought to (kiss) his (hands) (strong preterite 3rd sg. quiso + enclitic le reduced to l; = le quiso)
glossary.merçed: merçed — mercy, favor; Merçed! 'have mercy, I beg you' (= merced)
glossary.echado: echar — cast out, exiled (past part.; = echado)
glossary.fem: fem — behold me, here I am (fe + me, presentative; = heme aquí)
glossary.ffijas: fija — daughter (pl.; variant spelling with ff of fijas; = hijas)
glossary.iffantes: infante — child, young child (pl., spelt with ff; = niños); also a young man of noble birth
glossary.chicas: chico — small, little (fem. pl.; de días chicas 'small in days', i.e. young; = chicas)
glossary.aquestas: aqueste — these (fem. pl. demonstrative, reinforced; = estas)
glossary.quien: quien — who, whom (relative pronoun, also with a plural antecedent; = quien, quienes)
glossary.estades: estar — you are (2nd pl. present, old -ades ending; = estáis)
glossary.ida: ida — departure, going (noun; estar en ida 'to be about to depart'; = ida)
glossary.partir: partir — to part, separate (infinitive; partir nos emos 'we shall part')
glossary.dadnos: dar + nos — give us! (imperative 2nd pl. dad + enclitic nos; = dadnos)
glossary.amor: amor — love; por amor de 'for the love of'
glossary.enclinó: enclinar — he lowered, bent, inclined (preterite 3rd sg.; = inclinó)
glossary.sues: su — his, her (fem. pl. possessive, old sue/sues; = sus)
glossary.braço: braço — arm (= brazo); braço' = braços, the plural with its s lost before las
glossary.prendía: prender — he took, grasped (imperfect 3rd sg.; = prendía)
glossary.llególas: llegar + las — he brought them close (preterite 3rd sg. llegó + enclitic las; = las llegó)
glossary.quería: querer — he/I loved, wished (imperfect 1st/3rd sg.; ca mucho las quería 'he loved them'; = quería)
glossary.mientre: mientre — adverb-forming suffix, 'in a manner' (Latin mente; fuerte mientre = fuertemente)
glossary.mie: mie — my (fem. sg. of mio, before a noun; = mi)
glossary.emos: aver — we have (present 1st pl., hemos without the h; = hemos); after an infinitive, the auxiliary of a split future (partir nos emos = nos partiremos)
glossary.fincaredes: fincar — you will remain, stay (future 2nd pl.; = quedaréis)
glossary.remanida: remaner — left behind, remaining (past part. fem.; = quedada)
glossary.plega: plazer — may it please (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; plega a Dios 'may it please God'; = plazca)
glossary.case: casar — (that) I may marry off (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = case)
glossary.quede: quedar — (that) there may remain (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quede)
glossary.fazen: fazer — they make, give (present 3rd pl.; grand yantar le fazen 'they give him a great feast'; = hacen)
glossary.tañen: tañer — they ring, toll (present 3rd pl.; = tañen)
glossary.clamor: clamor — clamor, tolling, loud peal; a clamor 'tolling loudly'
glossary.odiendo: oír — hearing (gerund, with the old intervocalic d; = oyendo)
glossary.pregones: pregón — public proclamation, crier's announcement (pl.; = pregones)
glossary.unos: uno — some (masc. pl.; unos … otros 'some … others')
glossary.onores: onor — estate, landed property, honor (pl.; = honores)
glossary.aqués: aquese — that (masc. demonstrative, cut short; = ese)
glossary.juntados: juntar — gathered, assembled (past part. masc. pl.; son juntados 'have assembled'; = juntados)
glossary.demandan: demandar — they ask (for), inquire (present 3rd pl.; demandar por 'to ask after'; = demandan)
glossary.cojó: coger — he gathered, took (preterite 3rd sg., spelt with j; = cogió); with se, 'to join': con ellos' cojó = con ellos se cogió, 'he joined them'
glossary.vansse: ir + se — they go off (present 3rd pl. van + enclitic se, spelled -ss-; = se van)
glossary.naçió: nacer — he was born (preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
